acceptance_criteria.criterion: isDryRun() returns true for files starting with dry_run: true run_start event
isDryRun() returns false for unreadable/empty/malformed files
findRunLogs() populates is_dry_run on each returned entry

summary: Added is_dry_run: boolean to RunLogEntry interface in log-resolver.ts
Implemented isDryRun() internal helper — reads first non-empty JSONL line, returns true only when action === 'run_start' && dry_run === true, returns false on empty/malformed/unreadable files
Updated findRunLogs() to call isDryRun() concurrently with isRunActive() via Promise.all per file, populating is_dry_run on every returned RunLogEntry
Added 7 new tests to log-resolver.test.ts covering all acceptance criteria cases for isDryRun behaviour via findRunLogs
Added 2 new tests to run-log-handlers.test.ts verifying handleListRunLogs passes through is_dry_run on entries
All 87 tests in the two targeted files pass; full suite pre-existing failures (14) are in dialogue/api tests unrelated to this WP; TypeScript type check clean

comments.note: log-resolver.ts: isRunActive() and isDryRun() both read the full file content independently. A future optimisation could merge them into a single read that extracts both the first and last non-empty lines in one pass, reducing I/O for large log files. The current dual-call pattern mirrors the existing code style and is acceptable for typical log sizes.
log-resolver.ts: The RunLogEntry JSDoc comment previously described only is_active. The new is_dry_run field now has an accompanying doc comment in the interface — consistent with the existing style.

summary: isDryRun() implementation is clean and correct: reads first non-empty JSONL line, uses strict === true check (correctly rejects string or falsy values), error paths return false consistent with spec.
findRunLogs() uses Promise.all([isRunActive, isDryRun]) for concurrent per-file I/O — good pattern.
RunLogEntry interface extension is well-typed with a JSDoc comment consistent with the existing is_active documentation.

Dual I/O read pattern (isRunActive + isDryRun reading the same file independently) noted — acceptable given it mirrors the existing codebase style; a future optimisation opportunity already flagged by the Developer.

Test coverage is thorough: 7 tests in log-resolver.test.ts cover true/false/false-explicit/empty/malformed/wrong-action/every-entry-has-boolean scenarios; 2 passthrough tests in run-log-handlers.test.ts confirm the API layer propagates the field. All acceptance criteria are met.

comments.note: isDryRun() and isRunActive() each call readFile() independently per log file. A future optimisation could extract a single readFile() result and derive both the first and last non-empty lines in one pass (see Developer's own note). Not a concern for typical log file sizes, but worth revisiting if large log files become common.

notes: Backend enrichment complete: RunLogEntry.is_dry_run is now populated by findRunLogs() and flows through handleListRunLogs() to API consumers. The next implementation layers (CSS badge, project-detail.js run list badge, run-log.js dry-run event renderers) can now consume is_dry_run from the API response without any further backend changes.
WP-001 backend is approved. RunLogEntry.is_dry_run is correctly populated and flows through the API. WP-003 and WP-004 frontend work can safely consume is_dry_run from the run log list endpoint.
